up: Retrieve up to 1000 IC50 activity records for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1293267 (G-protein coupled receptor 35). Filter for rows with an exact standard relation ('=') and non-null pChEMBL values. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Sort the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID, and limit the output to the first 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293267'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
